title: Change spec frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a change's spec.md (after YAML-to-JSON conversion). A change is an experiment (EXP-NNNN) or a verifier change (VER-NNNN) — both use the same spec machinery; VER specs additionally fill the `verifier` block.

parent.description: Change this one derives from; null for a root experiment or a standalone verifier change.

compare_to.description: Experiments whose recorded numbers ground the assertions (the runs to beat). Defaults to [parent] when non-empty parent exists.

iteration.description: Current iteration of the agent loop, starting at 1.

hypothesis.description: One falsifiable claim with a concrete expected effect.

diff.description: Generalized diff vs the parent. Root experiments pin data and evaluation absolutely instead of as a diff.

scope.description: File allowlist the implementation may touch. Must never include experiments/, knowledge/, or .harness/checkers/.

config.description: Config keys changed vs the parent's resolved config, e.g. {"model.attn_dropout": {"from": null, "to": 0.1}}.

data.description: Dataset/version/hash/split changes vs parent; full pinning for roots.

evaluation.description: Benchmark and metric-definition changes vs parent; full list for roots.

at.description: When the assertion is evaluated, e.g. "step 10000" or "end of training".

condition.description: Threshold grounded in a real number from a compare_to record, e.g. "<= 2.29".

source.description: Experiment id the reference number comes from.

budgets.description: Resource bounds, e.g. wall_clock_hours, gpu_memory_gb, min_steps_per_sec.

artifacts_expected.description: Manifest of artifacts the run must produce.

decision_rule.description: What result means accept / reject / inconclusive / revise, including early-kill thresholds.

assumptions.description: Obvious-but-real off-spec decisions logged during iterations for human review.

verifier.description: Present only for verifier changes (VER-NNNN): what verification is being implemented or modified.

verifies.description: What property of an experiment this verification checks, and what its failure suggests.

calibration.description: Known cases the finished verifier must classify correctly — at least one known-good (expect pass) and one known-bad (expect fail).

registry_entry.description: Draft of the knowledge/verifications.md entry to merge on acceptance.
